bounded_code_observations: Opens all four libraries at version 37 before parsing.

Parses seven ReadArgs result slots, stores SIZE/N as the low 16 bits of TextAttr.ta_YSize, and rejects that word when it is at or below four with IoErr 115; high input bits do not affect the comparison.
Builds a TextAttr with style bits for ITALIC, BOLD and UNDERLINE, and adjusts proportional/designed flags.
Ensures the requested name has a case-insensitive .font suffix before OpenDiskFont.

If PROP is absent, rejects a returned proportional TextFont by closing it and setting IoErr 212; with PROP, this check is skipped. Offset evidence is expanded in setfont-proportional-font-audit-20260925.json.

Initializes result to RETURN_FAIL and IoErr to 122; ReadArgs failure retains RETURN_FAIL with its IoErr, SIZE <= 4 uses IoErr 115, missing console task retains IoErr 205, and a missing Window returns success. Detailed control-flow evidence is in setfont-result-policy-audit-20260925.json.

Obtains the current process console task and sends DOS DoPkt ACTION_DISK_INFO (25) with a BPTR to InfoData; reads the console Window pointer from InfoData.id_VolumeNode, calls graphics SetFont on Window.RastPort, closes the prior font, and stores the replacement at Window.Font. Offset evidence is expanded in setfont-console-window-audit-20260925.json.
Writes console escape sequences for italic, bold and underline through the current DOS output and flushes it.
evidence_limits: The bounded packet/window HUNK observations and public layout evidence do not establish behavior of the selected Workbench console handler, exact guest output, or result/IoErr precedence.
The media protection word has P clear; runtime PURE/resident behavior remains unobserved.
This audit does not authorize copying the original binary or claiming shipping equivalence.
